instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure the landing page is a single-page immersive portfolio for Rupesh Dev that immediately commands attention from recruiters.
2. Implement the kinetic hero section with particle effects background, masked headline animations, key metrics ($1.8M ARR, 92.5% CSAT), and fast action buttons.
3. Build the featured FinPilot card prominently in the AI Product Showcase with rich fintech description, interactive metric preview, live modal, and tech stack tags.

4. Create the playable AI Game component ('Neural Snake') with dual mode: Manual Arrow Key controls and 'AI Autopilot' mode where the snake plays automatically using a pathfinding algorithm with live AI thought process logs.

5. Build the 'Ask My CV' AI Chatbot floating widget and modal with recruiter quick chips ('Why hire Rupesh?', '$1.8M Portfolio details', 'SAP Experience', 'FinPilot architecture') and smart responses.
6. Build the 3-Chapter Manifesto section detailing his transition from SAP Consultant to Enterprise CS Leader to AI Product Builder.
7. Include the Editorial Marquee, CV Experience Matrix timeline, Skills Radar/Grid, Certifications, and high-impact Terminal Footer with Email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and Resume Download button.
8. Ensure all interactive components include data-testid attributes as specified in the testing guidelines.
9. Use Sonner for toast notifications when recruiters copy emails, resume links, or trigger chatbot actions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (do not add .App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) to prevent cramped UI.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.
